system.description:
Weapon Kit — Lob elemental grenades — cryo by default, with fire, smoke and concussion options.

Cryo Grenade (basic) — 1 Action. Range 6, Damage: 2d6 Cold. Targets adjacent to the space take half damage.

Toolbelt (2 Actions):

  • Flame Grenade. Range 6, Blast 3, Damage: 2d6 Fire. On hit: applies Smoldering. Can still crit or miss. The area burns for 1 round; targets take INT Fire damage for each space they enter on a turn. Ignores armor.
  • Smoke Grenade. Range 6, Blast 3. The area fills with thick smoke for 1 minute or until dispersed. Smoke obstructs view and can't be seen through.
  • Concussion Grenade. Range 6, Blast 2. On a failed STR save, targets are Blinded, Dazed and Slowed, 1 turn. On a save, they are only Dazed.

High Levels: +5 damage every 5 levels (Cryo Grenade & Flame Grenade).

[A] Grants the Grenade Kit item (basic ability, 1 Action, no scrap) and one feature per Toolbelt option (2 Actions, 1 Toolbelt scrap each, spent natively). Scraps are tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] High-level damage/healing bonuses are built into the formulas.

[M] Weapon Kits count as weapons for swapping and stowing.
